statement: ∀ (c : CharP K p) (rho : LR.R p →+* K), letI := c; letI := rho.toAlgebra; LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor K K (LR.pMR p M).subtype) = ⊥
proof:
intro c rho
letI := c
letI := rho.toAlgebra
rw [LinearMap.range_eq_bot]
apply LinearMap.ext
intro z
induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
| zero => simp only [map_zero]
| add z w hz hw => simp only [map_add, hz, hw, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero]
| tmul k m =>
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := m.property
  change TensorProduct.tmul (LR.R p) k (m : LR.MR p M) = 0
  rw [← hu]
  change TensorProduct.tmul (LR.R p) k ((p : LR.R p) • u) = 0
  rw [← TensorProduct.smul_tmul]
  have hpk : (p : LR.R p) • k = (0 : K) := by
    simp [Algebra.smul_def]
  rw [hpk, TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
